system.summary: Numeric nomenclator 3-368: letters with homophones, syllables, words and names; 355 and 365-368 used as nulls. Same code 1691-1694, for the King and for Pontchartrain.

prior_solution.where: Inventory FRAN_IR_003977 marks the five pieces 'non déchiffré'; catalogue 539 vetting (2 Nov 2026) found no edition or decipherment; the period decipherments of ff. 376 and 452 (same volume) were used as key source only.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout ordered and paid the reproduction (Archives nationales) and set the protocol; AI agents transcribed (blind passes and arbiter), built the key, measured and read.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Glossed letters ff. 376 and 452 transcribed with their interlinear decipherment; the five undeciphered pieces transcribed in two blind passes plus a blind arbiter.
Key from f. 376 by EM alignment of number runs with the gloss, hand-curated (KEY_v1, frozen); pre-registered held-out test on f. 452: 0.830 vs best of 200 controls 0.102, below the 0.85 bar (fail).
Five pieces decoded with KEY_v2 (v1 + omitted f. 376 values + f. 452 gloss values); context-only values counted as holes.

validation.notes: Pre-registered held-out test on f. 452: character agreement 0.830, best of 200 permuted-key controls 0.102; criterion >= 0.85 and >= control + 0.30 -> not met (absolute bar). Portion burnt; key not validated at the standard bar.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.fraction_read_source: rule of #728: 240 sure words of 272 cipher words (reading.md); probables, restorations and context-only values are holes.

credits.note: Reproduction ordered from the Archives nationales; key from the volume's period decipherments; five undeciphered pieces read in part

gaps.detail: 4 groups lost in the binding (0233 L, 0243 L, 0439 L)
no fresh glossed portion to validate KEY_v2: the 16 further glossed pieces of AE/B/I/381 (f. 131, 222, 261, 289, 317, 325, 330, 339, 398, 400, 409, 422, 425, 448, 470, 472) are not ordered
one occurrence in the glossed letter (after Benincasa), no second glossed letter to test it; key.tsv and decryption.txt treat it as a null, the frozen KEY_v1/v2 say "a"
the Archives nationales were not asked whether the images may be analysed with an AI assistant; the order was placed declaring private use
